name: Unsloth
description: Unsloth Studio is a local web UI for running and fine-tuning language models. It downloads and serves GGUF, LoRA and safetensors models, compares models side by side, and exposes OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints for tools like Claude Code and Codex.

notes.text: Log in as unsloth with the password from ~/unsloth.creds in the container. To change it, run unsloth studio reset-password, which prints a new one.
Fine-tuning needs an NVIDIA GPU passed through to the container; without one, inference and export still work. After adding or changing a GPU, run the update to get matching builds.
Models are stored in /opt/unsloth_data and fill the disk fast (a 7B model at Q4 is about 4 GB). Add disk space if you plan to keep several.
